datePolicy: Original ledger dates all retained sources 2026-11-05, including the MEA 403 retrieval. No fresh external checks. Future availability, utility tariffs, entry rules and service conditions are not confirmed.
uncertainties: All March 2027 vacancies, landlord identity, condition, station walks, internet speeds and reliability remain unconfirmed; advertisements are not offers or tested services.
Aspire size/annual-field conflicts, Park Origin six-month deposit/advance, Haus 23 price conflict and other ND terms remain unresolved. Pool/gym evidence is missing for several units.
Budgets, area preferences, setup and temporary accommodation are estimates; monthly sums omit insurance, visa/extension/travel, flights, tax, coworking, leisure and contingency.
MEA calculator returned 403; current numeric tariff/Ft and March 2027 rates not verified. MWA historical residential schedule is not a condo invoice.

OCPB scope depends on contracting operator portfolio; appendices and detailed mandatory refund/termination provisions not audited. TM30 extracted clause wording differs; stricter retained guidance used.

London jurisdiction, exact checklist, visa decision/stamps/extensions, DTV work restrictions and 2027 cross-border tax treatment need case-specific confirmation. Calendar months exceed day-based permissions.
editingContract: Readable corresponding English and Simplified Chinese lines and table cells retain identical complete numeric, currency, date and URL literals. Local drafts only; no stars or review markup.
audience: English for overseas remote workers planning Bangkok rentals; Simplified Chinese for Chinese-speaking readers comparing the same rental, visa and work-from-home decisions.
